text: “ଚାଳିଶ” ମାନେ ୪୦। ତେବେ “ଅଣଚାଳିଶ” କେତେ?
gloss: "Chalisha" is 40. So what is "anachalisha"? — 39: the prefix "ana" makes a ten one less (anatirisha 29, anachasha 49).

text: ହିନ୍ଦୀରେ “ଜାତା ହୈ” ଓ “ଜାତୀ ହୈ” ଅଲଗା। ଓଡ଼ିଆରେ “ସେ ଯାଉଛି” କାହା ପାଇଁ କୁହାଯାଏ?
gloss: Hindi says "jata hai" / "jati hai". Whom is Odia "se jauchhi" said of? — Either a boy or a girl: Odia verbs carry no gender. Elders take the honorific "jauchhanti" instead.

text: କେଉଁ ଶବ୍ଦର “ଳ” ବଦଳରେ “ଲ” ଲେଖିଲେ ତାହା “ଯିବା”ର ଅତୀତ ରୂପ ହୋଇଯିବ?
gloss: In which word does swapping ଳ for ଲ give the past tense of "to go"? — ଗଳା (throat) → ଗଲା (went). କଳା → କଲା (did), ଖୋଳା → ଖୋଲା (open); ଖେଲା is not Odia.

text: ନୀଳାଦ୍ରି ବିଜେ ଦିନ ଅଭିମାନିନୀ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ମୀଙ୍କୁ ମନାଇବାକୁ ଜଗନ୍ନାଥ କେଉଁ ମିଠା ଭେଟି ଦିଅନ୍ତି?
gloss: On Niladri Bije, which sweet does Jagannath offer to win over the sulking Lakshmi? — Rasagola; the day is kept as Rasagola Dibasa.

text: ଚିଲିକାର ସାତପଡ଼ାରୁ ଡଙ୍ଗାରେ ବସି ପର୍ଯ୍ୟଟକମାନେ କେଉଁ ଜଳଚର ଦେଖିବାକୁ ଯାଆନ୍ତି?
gloss: From Satapada on Chilika, tourists take boats to see which water animal? — Irrawaddy dolphins, Chilika's best-known residents.

text: ପୁରୁଣା ସାଧବଙ୍କ ସମୁଦ୍ରଯାତ୍ରା ମନେପକାଇ କାର୍ତ୍ତିକ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣିମାରେ କଟକରେ ବସୁଥିବା ବଡ଼ ମେଳା କେଉଁ ଦ୍ୱୀପ ନାଁରେ?
gloss: Cuttack's big Kartika Purnima fair, recalling the old sea traders' voyages, is named after which island? — Bali: Bali Jatra.

text: ସମ୍ବଲପୁର ପାଖରେ ଥିବା ହୀରାକୁଦ ବନ୍ଧ କେଉଁ ନଦୀକୁ ବାନ୍ଧିଛି?
gloss: Which river does the Hirakud Dam near Sambalpur hold back? — The Mahanadi.

text: “ସମାଜ” ଖବରକାଗଜ ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠା କରିଥିବା କାହାକୁ “ଉତ୍କଳମଣି” କୁହାଯାଏ?
gloss: Who, founder of the newspaper "The Samaja", is called "Utkalmani"? — Gopabandhu Das. Madhusudan Das is "Utkal Gourab".

text: ହିନ୍ଦୀ ସିନେମା ଜଗତ ବଲିଉଡ୍। ଓଡ଼ିଆ ସିନେମା ଜଗତର ଡାକନାମ କ'ଣ?
gloss: Hindi cinema is Bollywood. What is the Odia film industry called? — Ollywood. Tollywood is Telugu/Bengali, Mollywood Malayalam, Sandalwood Kannada.

text: ସାବିତ୍ରୀ ବ୍ରତରେ ଯମଙ୍କଠାରୁ ସ୍ୱାମୀଙ୍କ ଜୀବନ ଫେରାଇ ଆଣିଥିବା ସାବିତ୍ରୀଙ୍କୁ ମନେପକାଯାଏ। ତାଙ୍କ ସ୍ୱାମୀ କିଏ?
gloss: Savitri Brata remembers Savitri, who won her husband's life back from Yama. Who was her husband? — Satyavan. Nala is Damayanti's husband, Dushyanta Shakuntala's, Abhimanyu Uttara's.

text: ଢଗଟି ପୂରଣ କରନ୍ତୁ: “ଅଧିକ ଯୋଗୀ ମଠ …”
gloss: Complete the saying "Too many yogis, the monastery …" — goes hungry (ଉପାସ): the Odia "too many cooks".

text: ନିଜେ ଦକ୍ଷ ବୈମାନିକ ଥିବା କେଉଁ ନେତାଙ୍କ ନାଁରେ ଭୁବନେଶ୍ୱର ବିମାନବନ୍ଦର?
gloss: Bhubaneswar airport is named after which leader, himself a skilled pilot? — Biju Patnaik (Biju Patnaik International Airport).

text: ୱେବସାଇଟ “ମୁଁ ରୋବଟ ନୁହେଁ” ଟିକ କରିବାକୁ ବା ବସ ଥିବା ଛବି ବାଛିବାକୁ କହେ। କାହିଁକି?
gloss: A site asks you to tick "I'm not a robot" or pick the pictures with buses. Why? — To tell a human from a bot (a CAPTCHA).

text: ଡାଏଲିସିସ୍ ମେସିନ ଶରୀରର କେଉଁ ଅଙ୍ଗର କାମ କରେ?
gloss: A dialysis machine does the work of which organ? — The kidneys: it filters waste from the blood.

text: ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ବେଳେ ଟିକ୍-ଟିକ୍ କରି ସଙ୍ଗୀତଜ୍ଞଙ୍କୁ ସମାନ ଲୟ ଧରାଇ ରଖେ କେଉଁ ଯନ୍ତ୍ର?
gloss: Which device ticks during practice to keep a musician at a steady tempo? — The metronome.

text: ରଙ୍ଗୀନ ପଥର ବା କାଚର ଛୋଟ ଛୋଟ ଖଣ୍ଡ ଯୋଡ଼ି କାନ୍ଥ ବା ଚଟାଣରେ ଛବି ତିଆରି କଳାକୁ କ'ଣ କହନ୍ତି?
gloss: Pictures made of small pieces of coloured stone or glass on a wall or floor — what is the art called? — Mosaic. Fresco is paint on wet plaster, collage pasted paper.

text: ରୟାଲ ବେଙ୍ଗଲ ଟାଇଗରର ଘର ସୁନ୍ଦରବନ ଭାରତ ଓ କେଉଁ ଦେଶରେ ବିସ୍ତୃତ?
gloss: The Sundarbans, home of the Royal Bengal tiger, spread over India and which country? — Bangladesh, which holds the larger part.

text: ନେଭରଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡରେ ରହୁଥିବା, କେବେ ବଡ଼ ନ ହେଉଥିବା କାହାଣୀର ପିଲାଟି କିଏ?
gloss: Which storybook boy lives in Neverland and never grows up? — Peter Pan (J. M. Barrie).

text: ହଳଦିଆ ପୃଷ୍ଠଭୂମିରେ ଧଳା ଭୂତ — ଏହା କେଉଁ ଆପର ଲୋଗୋ?
gloss: A white ghost on a yellow background is which app's logo? — Snapchat.

text: ଛୁଇଁଦେଲେ ପତ୍ର ତୁରନ୍ତ ବୁଜି ହୋଇଯାଏ — ଏହା କେଉଁ ଗଛ?
gloss: Touch it and its leaves fold up at once — which plant? — Lajakuli, the touch-me-not (Mimosa pudica). The others are tulsi, mint and aloe vera.

text: ପନିର ପରି ଦେଖାଯାଉଥିବା ଟୋଫୁ କେଉଁ ଜିନିଷର ଦୁଧରୁ ତିଆରି?
gloss: Tofu, which looks like paneer, is made from the "milk" of what? — Soybeans: soy milk curdled and pressed.

text: ରୋୱାନ ଆଟକିନସନଙ୍କ କେଉଁ ଚରିତ୍ର ପ୍ରାୟ କିଛି କଥା ନ କହି ଦର୍ଶକଙ୍କୁ ହସାଏ?
gloss: Which Rowan Atkinson character makes people laugh while hardly saying a word? — Mr. Bean. Johnny English, also Atkinson, talks plenty.

text: ଫୁଟବଲ ନକଆଉଟ ମ୍ୟାଚ ଅତିରିକ୍ତ ସମୟ ପରେ ବି ଡ୍ର ରହିଲେ, ପେନାଲ୍ଟି ସୁଟଆଉଟରେ ପ୍ରଥମେ ପ୍ରତି ଦଳ କେତୋଟି କିକ୍ ନିଏ?
gloss: A football knockout tie still level after extra time: in the shoot-out each side first takes how many kicks? — Five, then sudden death.

text: ଲୁଡୁ ଖେଳରେ ଘରୁ ଗୋଟି ବାହାର କରିବାକୁ ଡାଇସରେ କେତେ ପଡ଼ିବା ଦରକାର?
gloss: In Ludo, what must the die show to bring a piece out of home? — A six.

text: ଡେବିଟ କାର୍ଡର ପଛପଟେ ଛପା ତିନି ଅଙ୍କିଆ ସୁରକ୍ଷା ସଂଖ୍ୟାକୁ କ'ଣ କହନ୍ତି?
gloss: What is the three-digit security number printed on the back of a debit card? — The CVV. The PIN is never printed, the OTP comes by SMS, IFSC identifies a bank branch.

text: ଲାଲ ଟୋପି ଓ ଘନ ନିଶ ଥିବା କେଉଁ ଭିଡିଓ ଗେମ ଚରିତ୍ର ପେସାରେ ପ୍ଲମ୍ବର?
gloss: Which video-game character with a red cap and a thick moustache is a plumber by trade? — Mario (Nintendo).

text: ଫୋନର ମୋବାଇଲ ଡାଟା ଲ୍ୟାପଟପ ସହ ବାଣ୍ଟିବାକୁ କେଉଁ ସୁବିଧା ଅନ କରିବେ?
gloss: Which phone setting do you switch on to share mobile data with a laptop? — The hotspot.

text: ପିଜାରେ ଟାଣିଲେ ଲମ୍ବା ସୂତା ପରି ବାହାରୁଥିବା ପନିର କେଉଁଟି?
gloss: Which cheese pulls into long strings on a pizza? — Mozzarella. Cheddar and parmesan are harder, feta crumbles.

text: ଟ୍ରେନ ଛାଡ଼ିବ ପାଉଣେ ନଅଟାରେ। ଡିଜିଟାଲ ଘଣ୍ଟାରେ ସେତେବେଳେ କ'ଣ ଦେଖାଯିବ?
gloss: The train leaves at "paune naata". What will a digital clock show? — 8:45: "paune" means a quarter less than the hour named.

text: ପ୍ରଥମାଷ୍ଟମୀ ଦିନ ଘରେ କାହାକୁ ବନ୍ଦାଣ କରି ଏଣ୍ଡୁରି ପିଠା ଖୁଆଯାଏ?
gloss: On Prathamashtami, who in the family is honoured with an arati and fed enduri pitha? — The first-born child.

text: “ତପସ୍ୱିନୀ”ର କବି, ବରପାଲିର ତନ୍ତି ପରିବାରରୁ ଆସିଥିବା କାହାକୁ “ସ୍ୱଭାବ କବି” କୁହାଯାଏ?
gloss: Which poet of "Tapaswini", from a weaver family of Barpali, is called "Swabhaba Kabi"? — Gangadhar Meher. Nanda Kishore Bal is "Palli Kabi", Radhanath Ray "Kabibara".

text: ୨୦୨୩ ପୁରୁଷ ହକି ବିଶ୍ୱକପ ଭୁବନେଶ୍ୱର ସହ ଓଡ଼ିଶାର ଆଉ କେଉଁ ସହରରେ ହୋଇଥିଲା?
gloss: The 2023 men's Hockey World Cup was played in Bhubaneswar and which other Odisha city? — Rourkela, at the new Birsa Munda stadium.

text: ଚନ୍ଦ୍ରଯାନ-୩ର ଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡରର ନାଁ ଭାରତୀୟ ମହାକାଶ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମର ଜନକ କେଉଁ ବୈଜ୍ଞାନିକଙ୍କ ନାଁରୁ ଆସିଛି?
gloss: Chandrayaan-3's lander is named after which scientist, father of India's space programme? — Vikram Sarabhai (the lander "Vikram"). Bhabha led the nuclear programme.

text: ନାଁରୁ ଅନୁମାନ କରନ୍ତୁ: “କାଳବୈଶାଖୀ” ଝଡ଼ ଓଡ଼ିଶାରେ କେଉଁ ଋତୁରେ ଆସେ?
gloss: Guess from the name: in which season does the "Kalbaisakhi" storm hit Odisha? — Summer (grishma): it is named after the month Baisakha (April–May), before the monsoon.

text: ଛତା, ଚାନ୍ଦୁଆ ଓ ବ୍ୟାଗରେ ରଙ୍ଗବେରଙ୍ଗ ଆପ୍ଲିକ କାମ ପାଇଁ ପୁରୀ ରାସ୍ତାର କେଉଁ ଗାଁ ପ୍ରସିଦ୍ଧ?
gloss: Which village on the Puri road is famous for colourful appliqué umbrellas, canopies and bags? — Pipili. Raghurajpur is the pattachitra village.

text: ₹୨୦୦ର ସାର୍ଟରେ “ଗୋଟିଏ କିଣନ୍ତୁ, ଗୋଟିଏ ମାଗଣା”। ପ୍ରତି ସାର୍ଟରେ ପ୍ରକୃତରେ କେତେ ପ୍ରତିଶତ ରିହାତି?
gloss: A ₹200 shirt on "buy one, get one free": what discount per shirt is that really? — 50%: two shirts for ₹200, ₹100 each. 100% is the autopilot trap.

text: “ଇମୋଜି” ଶବ୍ଦଟି ଇଂରାଜୀ “ଇମୋସନ”ରୁ ଆସିନାହିଁ। ଏହା କେଉଁ ଭାଷାର ଶବ୍ଦ?
gloss: "Emoji" does not come from English "emotion". Which language is it from? — Japanese: e (picture) + moji (character).

text: QR କୋଡ୍‌ର “Q” କେଉଁ ଶବ୍ଦକୁ ବୁଝାଏ?
gloss: What does the Q in "QR code" stand for? — Quick: Quick Response.

text: ସନସ୍କ୍ରିନର SPF ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ କେଉଁ ରଶ୍ମିରୁ ସୁରକ୍ଷା ମାପେ?
gloss: Sunscreen SPF measures protection mainly against which rays? — Ultraviolet (UVB, which causes sunburn).

text: ପୂରା କମ୍ପ୍ୟୁଟର ଆନିମେସନରେ ତିଆରି ପ୍ରଥମ ଫିଚର ଫିଲ୍ମ “ଟୟ ଷ୍ଟୋରି” କେଉଁ ଷ୍ଟୁଡିଓର?
gloss: "Toy Story", the first fully computer-animated feature film (1995), came from which studio? — Pixar.

text: ଆଫ୍ରିକାର ସର୍ବୋଚ୍ଚ ଶୃଙ୍ଗ କିଲିମାଞ୍ଜାରୋ କେଉଁ ଦେଶରେ?
gloss: Kilimanjaro, Africa's highest peak, is in which country? — Tanzania. It is close to the Kenyan border and often seen from Kenya, the trap.

text: ଇଂରାଜୀ “ସ୍ମଗ୍” ଶବ୍ଦ “ସ୍ମୋକ୍” (ଧୂଆଁ) ସହ ଆଉ କେଉଁ ଜିନିଷର ଇଂରାଜୀ ନାଁ ମିଶି ତିଆରି?
gloss: English "smog" is "smoke" plus the English name of what? — Fog (kuhudi): smoke + fog. Dust, cloud and steam don't fit the letters.

text: ଓଡ଼ିଶୀ ନୃତ୍ୟ ଓ ସଙ୍ଗୀତର ମୁଖ୍ୟ ତାଳବାଦ୍ୟ କେଉଁଟି?
gloss: What is the main percussion instrument of Odissi dance and music? — The mardala. The mridangam belongs to Carnatic music and Bharatanatyam.

text: ଉପେନ୍ଦ୍ର ଭଞ୍ଜଙ୍କ କେଉଁ କାବ୍ୟର ପ୍ରତିଟି ପଦ “ବ” ଅକ୍ଷରରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ?
gloss: Which Upendra Bhanja poem has every line beginning with the letter ବ? — Baidehisa Bilasa; fittingly the only title here that itself starts with ବ.

text: ଜଙ୍ଗଲରେ ଗାଢ଼ କଳା ଡୋରିଆ ଥିବା “କଳା ବାଘ” ଦେଖାଯାଉଥିବା ଓଡ଼ିଶାର ବ୍ୟାଘ୍ର ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପ କେଉଁଟି?
gloss: Which Odisha tiger reserve has "black tigers" with thick dark stripes in the wild? — Similipal, the only wild home of pseudo-melanistic tigers.

text: ଗତ ପ୍ରାୟ ତିନି ମାସର ହାରାହାରି ରକ୍ତ ଶର୍କରା କେଉଁ ପରୀକ୍ଷାରୁ ଜଣାପଡ଼େ?
gloss: Which blood test shows the average blood sugar over roughly the last three months? — HbA1c (glycated haemoglobin). TSH is thyroid, LFT liver, CBC blood count.

text: ଏଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ମୌଳିକ ସଂଖ୍ୟା?
gloss: Which of these is a prime number? — 53. The others have digit sums 6, 12 and 15, so 3 divides them (51 = 3×17, 57 = 3×19, 87 = 3×29).

text: ପୁରୀର ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ ଶ୍ରୀମନ୍ଦିର ନିର୍ମାଣ ଦ୍ୱାଦଶ ଶତାବ୍ଦୀରେ କେଉଁ ରାଜା ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିଥିଲେ?
gloss: Which king began building the present Jagannath temple in Puri in the 12th century? — Anantavarman Chodaganga Deva (Eastern Ganga). Narasimha Deva I built Konark; Kapilendra and Purushottama were later Suryavamsi kings.

text: ସମୁଦ୍ରପାରିର ଅଞ୍ଚଳ ମିଶାଇଲେ କେଉଁ ଦେଶରେ ସବୁଠୁ ଅଧିକ ସମୟ ମଣ୍ଡଳ (ଟାଇମ ଜୋନ)?
gloss: Counting overseas territories, which country spans the most time zones? — France (12). Russia and the USA have 11, the UK 9.

text: ଦୂରବୀକ୍ଷଣ ବିନା ବାଉଁଶ ଓ କାଠ ଯନ୍ତ୍ରରେ ଆକାଶ ମାପିଥିବା ପଠାଣି ସାମନ୍ତଙ୍କ ସଂସ୍କୃତ ଗ୍ରନ୍ଥର ନାଁ କ'ଣ?
gloss: What is the Sanskrit treatise of Pathani Samanta, who measured the sky with bamboo and wooden instruments and no telescope? — Siddhanta Darpana. Siddhanta Shiromani is Bhaskara II's, Aryabhatiya Aryabhata's, Surya Siddhanta an older classic.
